verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe Atlas files Delaware incorporation, issues founder equity, files 83(b) elections, and provides Cooley-drafted legal documents (bylaws, incorporation docs) viewable in the Dashboard — covering filing, bylaws, and equity/board-adjacent approvals end-to-end online. Community reviews corroborate a smooth, self-service incorporation experience, though some note extra state/local legwork and franchise tax surprises. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of initial board consent/resolution generation as a distinct step, and independent verification of 'board approvals' specifically rather than just equity issuance and bylaws.
